intro: Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre is a premier private addiction treatment facility in Ontario, offering a personalized, holistic approach to overcoming substance abuse. Unlike conventional rehab programs, we provide long-term residential treatment in a home-like setting, ensuring a comfortable and supportive environment for recovery. With a low client-to-staff ratio, we focus on individualized care, addressing both the physical and psychological aspects of addiction through Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), one-on-one and group counseling, relapse prevention strategies, aftercare support, and family counseling. At Another Road, we believe that recovery is a journey, and our evidence-based treatment methods, compassionate team, and tranquil setting make us a top choice for addiction recovery in Ontario. Start your journey to sobriety today with confidential consultation and customized treatment plans at Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre.

pillars.title: A Country House on 20 Acres Near Port Perry
pillars.body: Another Road is a private house on a 20-acre rural property at 10750 Ashburn Road, in the Township of Scugog outside Port Perry. Only 8 people stay at a time. Everyone gets a private room, and some rooms have their own ensuite bathroom. Meals are made in a large community kitchen, and there are lounges inside and out, plus a gym on the walkout lower level. Outside you have open fields to walk, a firepit and a BBQ area. The house is alcohol and drug free, and the centre set it up to feel like a home rather than a hospital.

pillars.title: An Exit Plan, Then the Alumni Program
pillars.body: Before you go home, you and your counsellor put together an exit plan. From there the Alumni Program keeps you in touch with the house and the people you met, and the centre lists lifetime aftercare among its services. Alumni can phone a counsellor, book in-person follow-up sessions and join private online alumni groups. There are on-site support meetings and alumni get-togethers too. If things get shaky, past clients can come back for a short stay and pay only a room and board fee.

pillars.title: A Small Team, Many With Lived Experience
pillars.body: The team is made up of addiction doctors, psychotherapists, counsellors and fitness and yoga instructors, and many of the staff are in recovery themselves. With 8 clients and a 1:3 staff-to-client ratio, you see the same faces every day and get proper one-on-one time. On arrival the Program Manager does your intake and shows you around. A licensed psychotherapist then meets with you alone to shape your plan, and the team reviews your progress daily so the plan can change when you do.

serviceCaption: 12 services, as described on the centre's website
afterOverview: Day to day, the program mixes clinical work with wellness. Clinical sessions cover cognitive behavioural therapy, relapse prevention and the stages of change, and counsellors also use experiential therapy and trauma-informed counselling. You are introduced to 12-Step, SMART Recovery and Refuge Recovery so you can find outside support that suits you once you are home. The week also includes yoga, fitness, Reiki, stress management and coping skills, with weekly meetings and group outings.

location.heading: Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre in Port Perry, Ontario
location.intro: Another Road is on Ashburn Road near Lakeridge Road, on a quiet stretch of countryside in the Township of Scugog, just outside Port Perry in Durham Region. Downtown Toronto is about an hour away by car, Whitby and Oshawa take roughly 30 minutes, and Uxbridge is about 20 minutes, so family visits are easy to plan from most of the GTA.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre cost?
faqs.a: Another Road's recovery.com profile gives an estimated cost of $500 per day, and says the price varies by program and length of stay. The centre does not post fees on its own website. Treatment is private pay and financing options are available, so ask admissions for an exact quote.

faqs.q: How long is the addiction treatment program?
faqs.a: Our core residential program runs 28 days. Within it, the program is flexible and adjusted to each person, with a focus on long-term recovery. Each client receives a customized treatment plan based on their progress.

No, Another Road does not provide detox on site. If you need withdrawal management first, the team will refer you to a trusted provider and help you move into the residential program once you are stable. Clients are usually asked to be at least 72 hours sober before they arrive.

faqs.q: Where is the centre located and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Another Road is at 10750 Ashburn Road in Port Perry, Ontario, in the Township of Scugog in Durham Region. Most people arrive by car. It is about an hour from downtown Toronto and around 30 minutes from Whitby and Oshawa.

faqs.q: Who can be admitted to the program?
faqs.a: The program is for adults 18 and over who want treatment, are seeking it voluntarily and are medically stable. Admission starts with a confidential assessment with the Program Manager, who asks about your substance use, withdrawal symptoms, mental health and any health or legal issues. If a bed is open, you can often start quickly.

faqs.q: Is this a private, paid centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Another Road is a private-pay residential centre. It works with financing partners to spread out the cost. Neither the centre's website nor its recovery.com profile lists any insurers it works with, so check with your benefits provider and the admissions team before you book.

faqs.q: What makes Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre different from other rehab facilities?
faqs.a: Another Road offers a private, home-like setting with a low client-to-staff ratio, ensuring personalized, long-term recovery plans tailored to each individual. We focus on a holistic approach that addresses both the physical and psychological aspects of addiction.

faqs.q: What types of addiction does Another Road treat?
faqs.a: We provide comprehensive addiction treatment for alcohol, opioids, prescription drugs, and other substance dependencies, using evidence-based therapies like CBT, DBT, counseling, and relapse prevention strategies.

faqs.q: Is family involvement part of the recovery process?
faqs.a: Yes, we believe that family support is crucial to long-term recovery. We offer family counseling and education sessions to help loved ones understand addiction and contribute to the healing process.

faqs.q: What happens after completing the program?
faqs.a: We provide comprehensive aftercare support, including relapse prevention strategies, counseling, and ongoing guidance to ensure clients maintain their sobriety and successfully transition back to everyday life.

Pack casual clothes for about a month (there is laundry on site), footwear for the house, walks and exercise, alcohol-free toiletries and your prescribed medication. Books, music, headphones, a journal and a few small comforts from home are welcome. The house is alcohol and drug free, so leave alcohol and any medication that isn't prescribed to you at home.
